speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent, and I need to understand the cause of your acute diarrhea. To start, how many loose stools have you passed in the last 24 hours, and have you noticed any blood or mucus in the stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhea (likely Clostridioides difficile infection)

Based on your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia and the development of frequent watery diarrhea, I need to confirm if you have had any fever or recent antibiotic use outside of the hospital. I will also order a stool test to check for C. diff toxins. REQUEST TEST: Stool_C_diff_toxin PCR
